72e2479bbb5eea0128fb8ca309856be3abd56f26.summary: Aqua Nautilus describes a campaign by the 8220 gang that exploited the Confluence flaw CVE-2022-26134 and targeted one of its honeypots. The attackers ran a container with a shell script that downloaded payloads, used cron jobs for persistence, shut down security tools and tampered with logs, then scanned for SSH hosts, brute-forced logins and reused saved SSH keys to spread. The payload was a cryptominer plus an IRC-controlled backdoor called Tsunami. The report says the script gained new components within a few days.
